units.source_text: 这女子看来并非没有才气。

en.t: This young woman did not seem to be without talent.

units.source_text: 围棋下毕，填空眼[\[3\]](#part1332.html#m3)时，看她非常敏捷；

en.t: When the game of go was over and she was filling in the liberties, she appeared extremely quick;

units.source_text: 一面口齿伶俐地说话，一面结束棋局。

en.t: she spoke with a sharp tongue while bringing the game to its close.

units.source_text: 空蝉则态度十分沉静，对她说道：“请等一会儿！

en.t: Utsusemi, by contrast, remained very calm and said to her, "Please wait a moment!

units.source_text: 这里是双活[\[4\]](#part1332.html#m4)呢。

en.t: This area is seki, with both sides alive.
And that ko over there..."

units.source_text: 轩端荻说：“呀，这一局我输了！

en.t: Nokiba no Ogi said, "Oh, I have lost this game!

units.source_text: 让我把这个角上数一数看！”

en.t: Let me count this corner and see!"

units.source_text: 就屈指计算：“十，二十，三十，四十……”

en.t: Then she bent her fingers and counted, "Ten, twenty, thirty, forty..."

units.source_text: 机敏迅速，仿佛恒河沙数也不怕数不完似的。

en.t: She was so clever and quick that she seemed unafraid even of counting grains of sand in the Ganges.

units.source_text: 只是品格略微差些。

en.t: Only her refinement was somewhat lacking.

units.source_text: 空蝉就不同：常常用袖掩口，不肯让人分明看到她的颜貌。

en.t: Utsusemi was different: she often covered her mouth with her sleeve and would not let people see her face clearly.

units.source_text: 然而仔细注视，自然也可看到她的侧影。

en.t: Yet if one looked closely, her profile could naturally be seen.

units.source_text: 眼睛略有些肿，鼻梁线也不很挺，外观并不触目，没有娇艳之色。

en.t: Her eyes were somewhat puffy, the line of her nose was not very straight, and her appearance was not striking, with no dazzling beauty about it.

units.source_text: 倘就五官一一品评，这容貌简直是不美的。

en.t: If one judged each feature separately, her face was simply not beautiful.

units.source_text: 然而全体姿态异常端严，比较起艳丽的轩端荻来，情趣深远，确有牵惹心目之处。

en.t: Yet her whole bearing was unusually dignified, and compared with the gorgeous Nokiba no Ogi, she had a deeper charm that truly drew the eye and heart.

units.source_text: 轩端荻明媚鲜妍，是个可爱的人儿。

en.t: Nokiba no Ogi was bright and fresh, a lovely young woman.

units.source_text: 她常常任情嬉笑，打趣撒娇，因此艳丽之相更加引人注目，是个讨人喜欢的女孩。

en.t: She often laughed freely, joked, and acted coy, so her brilliant beauty stood out all the more, making her a charming girl.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这是一个轻狂女子。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "She is a frivolous woman."

units.source_text: 然而在他的多情重色的心中，又觉得不能就此抹杀了她。

en.t: Yet in his amorous and beauty-loving heart, he felt he could not dismiss her for that alone.

units.source_text: 源氏公子过去看到的女子，大都冷静严肃，装模作样，连颜貌都不肯给人正面看一看。

en.t: Most women Prince Genji had seen before were calm, grave, and affected, unwilling even to let anyone see their faces from the front.

units.source_text: 他从来不曾看见过女子不拘形迹地显露真相的样子。

en.t: He had never before seen a woman reveal her true self so unconcerned with appearances.

units.source_text: 今天这个轩端荻不曾留意，被他看到了真相，他觉得对她不起。

en.t: Today Nokiba no Ogi had been careless and let him see her as she truly was, and he felt he had wronged her.

units.source_text: 他想看一个饱，不肯离开，但觉得小君好像在走过来了，只得悄悄地退出。

en.t: He wanted to keep looking until he was satisfied and was reluctant to leave, but sensing that Kogimi seemed to be coming, he had no choice but to withdraw quietly.
